Photograph of the white-border [[Bog-wing (Revised)]] card. The card was published by [[Decipher]]. The complete source photograph is available at the linked eBay image URL; the photographer is not identified.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/YjoAAOSwzVJlxnUj/s-l1600.webp complete card photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1200 × 1600-pixel source is retained unchanged. Rectangle (295, 390)–(930, 1185) was extracted with the right and bottom coordinates exclusive, retaining the complete photographed card and a narrow surrounding margin. It was downsampled with Lanczos resampling to 350 × 438 pixels and saved as PNG. Printed words, artwork, icons and borders were not repainted or reconstructed. This is a photographic crop. The source image’s holder or capture date is not used to infer the card’s first publication date.
